description: User establishes several user-level facts (location, role, preferred IDE) and then asks a question that should pull all three into context.

turns.content: Quick intro: I'm a backend engineer at a fintech startup.
Nice to meet you. What languages do you work in?
Mostly Python and a bit of Go for the high-throughput services.
Reasonable split. Where are you based?
Got it. I'll keep the timezone in mind.
Oh and I live in VS Code with Vim keybindings. Anything else is friction.
Fair. Most people I work with either go VS Code + Vim mode or full Neovim.
Yeah I tried Neovim, came back to VS Code for the extensions.
The extension ecosystem is a real moat.
summarize what you know about me

test_at.question: what does the user do for work, where, and which editor?
test_at.expected_fact: backend engineer at a fintech in London, uses VS Code with Vim keybindings
